61:504.name: Composer
61:504.description: Generate composer. Detail tags go in the Tags row. The Send button is exposed so it can switch to Stop.

44:10.name: State=Default
44:10.description: Composer attach. Opens the attach menu.

100:545.name: Stepper
100:545.description: A count picker inside the composer, like Variations. It sits inside a raised surface on surface/sunken. Decrease and Increase are exposed Stepper buttons, so their states can be set per instance.

102:569.name: Attach button
102:569.description: Composer attach. Opens the attach menu. Its fill flips between modes (surface/inverse), so Hover adds state/hover-inverse and Pressed state/pressed-inverse. Keyboard focus draws a 1px focus/ring 2px outside the edge, like the code’s :focus-visible outline. Turn on Focus to show it.

99:568.name: Compact select
99:568.description: The 28 tall picker inside the composer, like Any platform. It sits inside a raised surface, so it uses surface/sunken. Hover adds state/hover. Open holds state/pressed while the menu shows. Keyboard focus draws a 1px focus/ring 2px outside the edge, like the code’s :focus-visible outline. Turn on Focus to show it.

100:544.name: Stepper button
100:544.description: The round minus and plus buttons in a Stepper. Hover adds state/hover and Pressed adds state/pressed. Disabled is 32% opacity, as in the composer when the count is at its limit. Keyboard focus draws a 1px focus/ring 2px outside the edge, like the code’s :focus-visible outline. Turn on Focus to show it.

44:9.name: Send button
44:9.description: Composer send. Stop shows while a run is in progress. Slime in both modes, so Hover adds state/hover-on-color and Pressed state/pressed-on-color. Keyboard focus draws a 1px focus/ring 2px outside the edge, like the code’s :focus-visible outline. Turn on Focus to show it.

16:816.name: Trimmed/Body/L
16:816.description: Chat input and long-form reading. Cap-height trimmed for components spaced to the letterforms (chat box, tags).

42:3.name: Button/S
42:3.description: Button labels at 28 tall. Cap height trim keeps the label optically centered.

16:825.name: Elevation/Floating
16:825.description: Cards lifting on hover. Not used on the confirmed screens since the 2026-10-01 lock.
